d.title: Scheduled maintenance
d.body: Every Tuesday 04:00-05:00 (+08:00) the wallet service is read-only while reconciliation runs. Bets placed in that window settle normally.

d.title: Bank transfer cut-off moved to 22:30
d.body: Same-day crediting now requires the transfer to be made before 22:30 (+08:00). Later transfers are credited the next morning.

d.title: Rollover progress is now shown per promotion
d.body: Your turnover progress for each active bonus is visible under Account - History, so it is clear which bonus is still locked.

d.title: We never ask for your password
d.body: Support will never request your password, OTP or a wallet transfer. Report anyone who does through live chat.
